mapper.select: SELECT f.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img FROM feed f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND f.id = #{id}
SELECT f.*, u.nickname FROM feed f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC
SELECT f.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img FROM feed f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.check_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY f.like_count DESC, f.created_at DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM feed WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date DESC;

SELECT f.*, u.nickname FROM ( SELECT id FROM feed WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) k JOIN feed f ON f.id = k.id LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img FROM ( SELECT id FROM feed WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) k JOIN feed f ON f.id = k.id LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed ( user_id, challenge_id, image_url, content ) VALUES ( #{feedDTO.userId}, #{challengeId}, #{feedDTO.imageUrl}, #{feedDTO.content} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feed WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND id = #{id}
